    fn = f"{OUT}/core/{unit.replace(':', '_')}.parquet"
    r = pd.read_parquet(fn)
    boot, seed = int(r.boot.iloc[0]), int(r.seed.iloc[0])
    P = A.Prepared(get(unit))
    tb = P.bootstrap_theta(boot, np.random.default_rng(seed), by="cluster")
    tbi = P.bootstrap_theta(boot, np.random.default_rng(seed + 1), by="comparison")
    ga = tb[:, r.a.values] - tb[:, r.b.values]
    gi = tbi[:, r.a.values] - tbi[:, r.b.values]
    r["se_boot"], r["se_boot_cmp"] = ga.std(0, ddof=1), gi.std(0, ddof=1)
    r["p_flip_boot"], r["p_flip_boot_cmp"] = (ga <= 0).mean(0), (gi <= 0).mean(0)
    r["z_boot"] = r.gap / r.se_boot
    r["ncl"] = P.ncl
    r.to_parquet(fn)
    mfn = fn.replace(".parquet", ".models.parquet")
    mt = pd.read_parquet(mfn)
    rank_boot = np.argsort(np.argsort(-tb, axis=1), axis=1)
    mt["se_boot"] = tb.std(0, ddof=1)
    mt["rank_lo"], mt["rank_hi"] = np.percentile(rank_boot, 2.5, axis=0) + 1, np.percentile(rank_boot, 97.5, axis=0) + 1
    mt.to_parquet(mfn)
    print(unit, "refreshed, ncl", P.ncl, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
